title: [Shortcut Guide] Default "Hold Windows key" behavior interferes with Win+V and Win+H
summary: A maintainer identified existing Shortcut Guide settings that may avoid the reported interference and asked the reporter to confirm whether changing them resolves the problem.

judgment.rationale: The latest maintainer comment asks the reporter to test the existing close-on-Windows-key-release and hold-duration controls. The Needs-Author-Feedback label is current, so no duplicate request or fix design should be exposed until the reporter answers.
evidence: The issue remains reproducible with the default Hold Windows key behavior.
A collaborator explained that Clipboard History and Voice typing close when Shortcut Guide takes foreground and then closes.
The latest maintainer comment points to two existing controls and asks whether disabling close-on-release or increasing the hold duration helps.
judgment.recommended_action: Wait for the reporter to confirm whether the existing controls resolve the interference.

fix_assessment.rationale: A code change is not yet selectable because the current maintainer request is to determine whether supported settings already provide the required behavior.

issue_context.summary: Shortcut Guide's Windows-key hold behavior can interfere with Win+V, Win+H, and other Windows hold gestures, but existing settings may provide an acceptable workaround.
known_information: The behavior is reported on PowerToys 0.101.2362 and Windows 11 25H2.
Disabling Hold Windows key avoids the interference.
Shortcut Guide can be configured not to close when the Windows key is released.
The hold duration can be increased.
A maintainer has asked the reporter to test those controls.
inferences: If the settings resolve the workflow, the remaining question may be discoverability or defaults rather than an input-hook defect.
If they do not resolve it, the activation and foreground-ownership policy remains the likely investigation boundary.
issue_context.analysis: The newest upstream activity changes the next action from approving a design to waiting for a focused author confirmation. Repeating the maintainer's request would add no value.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue discussion and current labels.
Re-evaluated the prior activation-policy design against the maintainer's newly identified configuration controls.
